summary.text: PPA-CF is carbon-fibre-filled polyphthalamide. Makers sell it for automotive, aerospace, electronics, drone and robot parts. It is semicrystalline, so it carries light load well above its glass transition: its HDT at 0.45 MPa is 227 °C. On the H2C it prints at 285⁠–⁠310 °C, every product needs a hardened nozzle, and some chamber windows reach above the H2C's heated-chamber limit.
